name: Conversion
description: Conversion enables seamless conversion of various document formats (PDF, DOC) and images into text. Simply provide a URL for your PDF, DOC, or image file, and the plug will extract and convert the content into readable text. Ideal for users looking to quickly transform content from documents and images into an editable format for further processing or analysis.

events.n: Extract and Text from Document/Image URL
events.d: Extracts and converts text from PDF, DOC, or image URLs into readable text content.
Generates Image from given text prompt.
